bio.text: Hannah Pingree is the Democratic nominee for Governor of Maine in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She served in the Maine House of Representatives, representing District 36, from 2002 to 2010.
Pingree was born in Belfast, Maine, and earned a bachelor's degree from Brown University in 1998.
Her career includes serving as director of the Maine Governor's Office of Policy Innovation and the Future.
